name: Mister Negative

abilityDetails.Counter-Attack Evade: Rakip saldırılarından otomatik olarak kaçmayı sağlar.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Exhaustion: Rakibin kritik vuruş gücünü ve tetiklenme oranını azaltır.
abilityDetails.Petrify: Düşmanın iyileşme ve güç kazanım hızını azaltır.
abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Direct Damage: Zırh ve dirençleri yok sayan doğrudan hasar verir.

signatureAbility:
Corrupting Touch
Whenever a Nullify, Stagger, or Fateseal is prevented by Mister Negative's immunity, deal a burst of [1,160.12 - 5,279.47] Physical Damage.
While suffering from Degeneration, Regenerate +[2,093.65 - 3,171.42] Health per second.

immunityDetails:
• Silme (Nullify) Bağışıklığı 🔮
• %40 Dejenerasyon direnci (rakipteki her aktif olumsuz etki için) ☠️

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Mister Negative is immune to all Nullify, Stagger and Fateseal effects.
The potency of the Opponent's Degeneration effects are reduced by 40% for each unique Debuff they suffer.
When Evading, Mister Negative counter-attacks with a hit dealing a burst of [8,975.15] Physical Damage and granting the Opponent Power equal to a Medium Attack.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: The first hit grants a Fury Buff increasing Attack Rating by +[1,583.85] for 10 seconds.
While Charging a Heavy Attack, if 1 or more Light Energy are active, gain 100% Evade chance against Basic Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Light Energy
content: Whenever either champion performs a Well-Timed Block, gain +2 Light Energy.
Dashing back removes all Buffs on Mister Negative, granting +1 Light Energy per Buff removed.
Light Energy lasts indefinitely until reaching 10 stacks after which all stacks will expire over 6 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Dark Energy
content: If Mister Negative performs an Evade or is Knocked down, all Light Energy is converted into Dark Energy.
Dark Energy lasts indefinitely until reaching 10 stacks after which all stacks will expire over 16 seconds.
While suffering from Disorient, all Dark Energy is removed and additional Dark Energy cannot be gained.
Each time Dark Energy is gained, inflict a 60% Delirium Debuff lasting a flat 0.8 second(s) per Light Energy converted.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: A Delirious Opponent suffers -0.6% Defensive Combat Power Rate and has their Dash and Dodge controls reversed.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: On activation gain a Bulwark Passive for 30 seconds, increasing Block Proficiency by +[916.67] for each Light Energy, then convert all Light Energy into Dark Energy.
The final hit inflicts an Exhaustion Debuff, lowering the Opponent's Critical Damage Rating by [375] for 20 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The 1st hit inflicts a Petrify Debuff of 80% Potency for 20 seconds.
The 2nd hit inflicts another Petrify if 10 or more Dark Energy are active.
The 3rd hit inflicts a Degeneration Debuff, dealing up to [14,254.65] Direct Damage over 10 seconds.
The final hit consumes all remaining Dark Energy, inflicting 1 additional Degeneration for each Dark Energy consumed.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Inflict a 60% Delirium Debuff for 20 seconds.
All Light Energy is consumed, each Regenerating [1,648.84] Health.
All Dark Energy is consumed, each dealing a burst of [8,975.15] Direct Damage to the Opponent.
